title: Edge
tagline: Crates of tokenized US stocks, auto-rebalanced for easy investing.
description: Edges is a global investing platform that lets users buy real, fractional shares of U.S. stocks bundled into curated themes like “AI Leaders” or “Women-Led Enterprises.” Built on licensed infrastructure, Edges offers a narrative-first investing experience for users in India, Africa, LATAM, and SEA. Users invest in stories, not symbols while creators can build and monetize their own Edges. With transaction fees and creator subscriptions as revenue drivers, Edges brings accessibility, context, and global reach to U.S. equities in a way that legacy brokerages never could.
how_its_made: We built on top of the Dinari SDK, which powers Dstocks and ensures compliance with government regulations, including full KYC implementation. Dinari handles all the regulatory and technical heavy lifting, we focus on making it easy for users to seamlessly trade and invest in these tokenized US stocks. With our platform, users can manage their portfolios effortlessly and invest like professionals, just as seasoned traders do, while also gaining the opportunity to earn significant profits on top of that.
